detail.en: eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases, including airfare and in-flight purchases

highlights.zh: 阿拉斯加與夏威夷航空機上 Wi-Fi、飲品等消費 20% 回饋

highlights.en: 10% more points on all card purchases with an eligible Bank of America account
highlights.zh: 持有符合條件的 Bank of America 帳戶，所有刷卡點數加贈 10%

notes: Issued by Bank of America, whose own product page is ZIP-code gated; data taken from Alaska Airlines' official card page (source_url) on 2026-11-19. That page is built from embedded content data and shows a CAPTCHA to automated browsers, so the scheduled checker may fail to re-read it — verify by hand when it reports an error. Foreign transaction fee is not stated on that page, so fx_fee is omitted.
